name: Corporate Action Securities Movement 2
definition: Provides information about the securities movement resulting from the election instruction.

PostingDateTime.name: Posting Date Time
PostingDateTime.definition: Date and time of the posting of the movement.

PostingIdentification.name: Posting Identification
PostingIdentification.definition: Posting identification of the securities movement.

PostingQuantity.name: Posting Quantity
PostingQuantity.definition: Securities quantity posted as a result of the securities movement.

AccountDetails.name: Account Details
AccountDetails.definition: Provides information about the account which is debited/credited as a result of the movement.
